temperature.meaning: Air temperature at the virtual monitoring point

humidity.meaning: Relative humidity, not absolute moisture content

co2.meaning: Carbon dioxide concentration in parts per million

occupancy.meaning: Binary presence: 0 vacant, 1 occupied; not a people count

light.meaning: Illuminance at the virtual monitoring point, in lux

power.meaning: Instantaneous virtual electrical power in kW; not cumulative kWh

water_leakage.meaning: Binary moisture flag: 0 dry, 1 leak detected
